messages:
Priya - Sales: FYI DraxHealth just sent a compliance ask — they need retention of request + response logs for 7 years, per-request patient identifier mapping, and a signed attestation that we store audit logs in an immutable form. They want timeline and whether this is doable on hosted API. Link to their packet: https://drax.example/qna (customer doc)
Maria - PM: Thanks — can you paste the specific fields they need? important: is this retention of full request/response or just metadata? Also, is this a hard requirement for contract close?
Priya - Sales: They marked it as contract pre-req. Fields list in the doc: request_id, timestamp, client_id, model_id, prompt_hash, response_hash, pii_marker (boolean), patient_id (if present), redaction_status, originating_ip, user_agent, signer_id. They explicitly call out signature chain for logs and proof of immutability.
Sam - Eng: short answer: we can implement longer retention but hosted API storing PII for 7y is a compliance + risk change. Tech notes:
- storage: ~X TB/month at current throughput, cost + replication for immutability
- immutability: can use WORM bucket or append-only ledger + signed hashes
- pseudocode for retention config:
```
retention_policy: {
  retention_days: 2555, # 7y
  immutable: true,
  hash_chain: true
}
```
- purge job currently assumes 90d; we'd need to add config + backfill migration
Kai - Support: we handled a 2y retention ask last quarter, opened support ticket for export-based workaround. Customer wanted long-term logs but was okay with redacted exports and signer-attestation. FYI: shows up often with EHR customers.
Maria - PM: Proposal options to present to Drax:
1) Hosted add-on: 'Long-term audit retention' feature (configurable retention_days up to 7y) + immutability via signed hash chain. Requires legal + security signoff. Estimated dev: 8w for MVP, cost pass-through to customer.
2) Dedicated/Private deployment: full control, can meet 7y with KMS/HSM; longer lead time and higher cost.
3) Compromise: 2y retention on hosted + yearly signed attestation + redacted long-term exports for patient-level mapping on request. Lower cost, faster (2–4w for attestation docs).
Priya - Sales: Drax says 7y is non-negotiable for their auditor but might accept an attestation plus downloadable exports if we can show immutability and signed hashes. They want clear SLAs and a sample evidence package.
Sam - Eng: For backlog ticket, we should include acceptance criteria (minimal):
- Config flag to set retention_days up to 2555
- Logs include the listed schema fields (request_id, prompt_hash, response_hash, pii_marker, patient_id if present)
- Immutability: system produces signed hash chain and stores signatures in WORM storage
- Export API to fetch logs in CSV/NDJSON
- Access control: only authorized roles can request exports; all access logged
- Migration plan for existing 90d logs
Kai - Support: Evidence checklist for sales to hand to Drax:
- data_flow_diagram.pdf
- log_schema.json
- retention_policy.md
- KMS_key_rotation_policy.pdf
- sample_signed_hashes.txt
- SOC2 control references (CC6, CC7 etc)
:evidence-bot: Generated basic evidence bundle: /evidence/1898765432/draxseed.zip
Maria - PM: Good. Let's set launch criteria for the hosted add-on MVP:
MUST: configurable retention up to 7y, produce signed hash chain, export API, role-based access to exports
SHOULD: automation for signed attestation generation, cost-estimator for customers
COULD: UI in console for configuring retention and viewing hash chain
Acceptance test: internal QA runs backfill + verify hash chain for a sample 1M events, legal signs attestation template.
Priya - Sales: Pricing question — can you sketch a seat-of-the-pants estimate? Drax is willing to pay a premium but needs a number for the contract.
Sam - Eng: rough: storage + immutability infra + support = $X/month per TB. Dev + security ops eng effort for MVP ~ 8 FTE-weeks. I'll add more accurate numbers in the ticket.
Maria - PM: Actions:
- I will create PROD backlog ticket and label it compliance:retention and link Drax packet (ETA EOD)
- Sam to own tech design
- Kai to assemble evidence package draft for Drax
- Priya to negotiate interim acceptance (2y + attestation) while we scope full 7y offering
Timeline expectations: attestation docs in 2–3w, hosted add-on MVP 8–10w pending legal/security.
Priya - Sales: 👍 I'll tell Drax we can provide an attestation quickly and will follow up once the ticket is live. Will push for contract flexibility.
Maria - PM: I'll post the ticket link here once created. tagging @Sam and @Kai :eyes:
Sam - Eng: noted, will drop a short design doc in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Kai - Support: will start drafting evidence bundle and flag any missing artifacts. :white_check_mark:
Priya - Sales: thanks team — keeping this thread live for quick Qs.
